sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L225-S01 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A boy classmate has done something wrong and is sincerely admitting the mistake to the recurring teacher, then starting to make it right by tidying a messy classroom table.
Visual cast: boy classmate, preschool age, visually distinct from the protagonist girl; recurring teacher identity, tidy classroom clothing, calm instructional posture, visually distinct from protagonist mother and not copied from L058 adult woman.
Scene/backdrop: warm classroom with a table that has scattered safe classroom objects being neatly arranged; no readable papers or labels.
Composition/framing: center the teacher, boy, messy table, and tidying action; keep all meaning-bearing objects inside safe margins for a square phone card.
Style/medium: use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean environment, expressive preschool proportions, bright warm palette. Do not copy any specific person from L058.
Constraints: clearly show both apologizing/admitting mistake and making amends; no text, no numbers, no labels, no signs, no writing, no watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 男孩同學做錯事後，正在向主角老師認錯，並開始改過，例如把弄亂的桌子整理好。老師必須和主角媽媽視覺上不同。畫面要同時表現認錯和改過；不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.text: 不知道怎麼畫，改了又改。
sentences.spokenText: 不知道怎麼畫改了又改
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L225-S02 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. The protagonist little girl sits at a desk drawing, unsure how to draw well; several erased, revised, or crumpled draft papers are on the table while she redraws the picture.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip, matching L154/L162/L163 continuity and not copied from L058.
Scene/backdrop: warm home desk or classroom art table; papers contain only simple pictures and sketch marks, never readable writing.
Composition/framing: center the girl, drawing tool, revised drafts, and current picture; safe margins for square crop.
Style/medium: L058 style only as illustration treatment: warm pencil-and-watercolor children's picture-book look, soft natural light, detailed clean desk environment.
Constraints: show uncertainty and repeated revising; no text, no numbers, no labels, no readable marks, no watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩坐在桌前畫圖，因為不知道怎麼畫才好，桌上有幾張被擦改過或揉掉的草稿，她正在重新修改圖畫。圖紙上只能有圖案，不可有字、數字或標籤。畫面重點是「不知道怎麼畫」和「改了又改」。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L225-S03 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. The protagonist little girl walks confidently with her school bag on a familiar sidewalk or neighborhood path near home; her home direction or warm home doorway is visible ahead without any written signs.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip, consistent with L154/L162/L163 family continuity.
Scene/backdrop: ordinary warm Taiwan neighborhood or home approach, safe pedestrian path, no road signs or door numbers.
Composition/framing: center the girl, path, and homeward direction; show calm confidence and recognition of the way home; keep safe margins.
Style/medium: L058 style-only warm pencil-and-watercolor children's illustration; do not copy L058 people.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no road signs, no door plates, no map labels, no watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩背著書包，走在熟悉的人行道或家附近小路上，前方能看到她家的方向或家門，她表情安心、有把握。畫面要表現她認得回家的路；不可有路牌文字、門牌、地圖文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.text: 褲子拿錯了，改天去換回來。
sentences.spokenText: 褲子拿錯了改天去換回來
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L225-S04 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At home, the protagonist little girl realizes she brought home the wrong pair of school pants; protagonist mother gently reminds her to take them back and exchange them later.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; protagonist mother in white or beige top, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair, warm family role, visually distinct from teacher and passersby.
Scene/backdrop: warm home entry or bedroom corner with a school bag, plain school clothes cue, and one plain pair of wrong pants in the girl's hands.
Composition/framing: center mother, girl, school bag, and wrong pants; no changing clothes; safe square margins.
Style/medium: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework in L058 style only; family continuity from L154/L162/L163.
Constraints: no name tags, no school name, no text, no numbers, no size labels, no clothing tags, no logos, no watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩回到家後，發現書包裡或手上拿的是別人的校褲，主角媽媽在旁邊提醒她改天去學校把褲子換回來。畫面可有主角小女孩拿著一條不屬於自己的校褲，旁邊放著書包和校服作為學校線索；不可有姓名貼、校名、文字、數字、尺寸標籤，也不要畫更衣。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L225-S05 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. The protagonist little girl stands alone at a school gate area or safe sidewalk, hesitating because a passerby auntie in the distance is seen mostly from the back and looks a little like someone familiar, but the girl is unsure whether she recognized the wrong person.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; passerby auntie only, varied adult passerby identity, back or side-back view, visually not protagonist mother, not teacher, not godmother, not copied from L058 adult woman.
Scene/backdrop: safe school entrance edge or sidewalk with no readable signs; no mother, no teacher, no godmother in this image.
Composition/framing: center the girl's uncertain pause and the distant passerby auntie; make the uncertainty readable without speech bubbles; safe square margins.
Style/medium: L058 style only for warm pencil-and-watercolor illustration; do not copy any L058 person.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no labels, no signs, no dialogue bubbles, no watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩一個人在校門口或安全的人行道邊，看到遠處一位背影很像熟人的路人阿姨，正猶豫要不要打招呼。路人阿姨的背影、髮型或衣服顏色可以和主角小女孩認識的人有一點相似，但不能直接畫成媽媽、老師或乾媽；要讓畫面呈現「好像認得，又不確定有沒有認錯人」。不可有文字、數字、標籤或對話框。
